remaining_finding.detail: If merge has a Jackin or other unexpected conflict, the guard exits after git merge entered conflict state. finally removes the owned lock but does not run git merge --abort, leaving MERGE_HEAD/unmerged paths. Add a narrowly owned abort for unexpected-conflict exits, gated on no pre-existing merge state.
